svg.title: Core Web Vitals pass rate, mobile
svg.desc: Share of origins passing all Core Web Vitals on mobile devices for each platform, monthly from 2020-01 to 2026-09, from the HTTP Archive Tech Report. A dashed vertical line marks March 2024, when INP replaced FID in the definition, so the series is not strictly comparable across it. Shopify is highest, WooCommerce lowest. This is origin-level field data, not a controlled benchmark.
svg.text: Core Web Vitals pass rate, mobile
Origins passing Core Web Vitals, mobile (%)

text.tspan: Source: HTTP Archive Tech Report (cdn.httparchive.org/v1/cwv); retrieved 2026-10-27. Survivor bias may flatter the shrinking PrestaShop and Magento
populations. Raw data: scripts/ecommerce-comparison-charts/data/performance.csv. See the Bibliography for the sources.
